groups.unknown-random: random.Random(20260917).sample(20) of unknown with stated output, sorted by id

subjects.application: Use WM-02 to retain introduction, predecessor, admitted updates and cutoff. Produce the post-update distribution under its declared model. A prior-only row must remain labelled prior-only; missing carry cannot be repaired with uniform mass.
subjects.title: Establish the current distribution
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Retain each branch’s states, observations, transition interpretations and score contributions through the admitted horizon. Do not add a temporal discount merely because the seeded historical example uses one.
subjects.title: Evaluate actual branches
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Identify applicable posterior/temperature or precision law, input scale and mode. Produce a declared commitment contract; do not universally impose the seed’s simple softmax on an incompatible variational mode.
subjects.title: Pin the commitment law
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Keep full policy identities, prior and applicable F/G inputs unchanged except for the authorized modulation. Retain the consumed commitment value and resulting choice distribution.
subjects.title: Apply to the real candidate distribution
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Retain full policy, state, guards, execution history and source/model revision from selection. Produce the enactment contract; a pattern vector alone omits the semantics that determine behavior.
subjects.title: Freeze the selected interpretation
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Execute only the selected task-specific interpretation under actual available information. Retain attempts, guard decisions and partial failures. A code commit is not required when the authorized work is a data or specification artifact.
subjects.title: Perform the authorized response
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Query the appropriate external substrate using criteria derived from the authored task bindings. Produce a shape-appropriate witness of the actual effect, not the builder’s copied input or its own success field.
subjects.title: Acquire an independent actuation witness
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Retain the admitted source bytes, occurrence and cutoff, observation proposal and distinct exact-subject review. Produce an accepted finding or explicit insufficiency; an independence flag without provenance is not independent acquisition.
subjects.title: Acquire and review the exact finding
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Name whether this computation is a categorical update or a declared channel approximation. Retain its A, B, state and numeric meaning. The seeded Gaussian mean/variance example is not authority to apply that law to mission-status probabilities.
subjects.title: Identify the applicable update law
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Join the pre-update belief, action/occurrence, controlled B, independent observation and cutoff. Produce one update context; reject future evidence, wrong model and an event already consumed.
subjects.title: Bind the prior and event
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Apply transition propagation once, then the observation update required by the declared law. Retain intermediates and output. Initialization, identity propagation or a no-observation case must have those names, not measured-update credit.
subjects.title: Compute the admitted update
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Use WM-02/04/05 to declare state, observation and outcome meaning at each horizon step. Produce one model/policy input envelope; a signature-compatible constant bridge is not semantic correspondence.
subjects.title: Bind the modeled question
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Use WM-03’s real guards, history, order and full policy plan. Produce controlled transition inputs with measured-versus-declared provenance. Reject unhandled live actions rather than silently dropping them.
subjects.title: Resolve the interpreted dynamics
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Pass the resolved plan and actual belief through B and A over the declared schedule. Retain each step and model revision. The unused standalone machine predictor cannot stand in for the production consumer.
subjects.title: Compute complete predictions
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Take WM-08/09’s actual cascade family, including legal partial constructions. Explain how a response changes another pattern’s conditions or outcome. Produce candidate identities and interpretation context rather than isolated pattern merits.
subjects.title: Construct interacting alternatives
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Join current belief, A/B, matched Q/C and comparable observation schedule from WM-05/06/12. Produce the complete conditioning envelope; unsupported C support or missing model inputs remain explicit.
subjects.title: Bind the valuation context
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Consume WM-10’s canonical risk-plus-conditional-ambiguity calculation and independent numeric correspondence. Preserve joint-derived equivalences; do not subtract information gain from KL risk a second time. Produce per-policy components and totals.
subjects.title: Evaluate the canonical arrangement
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Record the actual choice reading those scores and the selected/enacted identity. For construction extensions retain parent/child comparison and the ruled strict improvement admission; this does not authorize non-improving extensions via sampling.
subjects.title: Demonstrate selection consumption
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Use strict registry/authority inputs for all open missions and live T-tickets. Retain included targets and explicit exclusions at the cutoff. Do not restore the old three-mission allow-list through an optimization or test fixture.
subjects.title: Acquire the authorized target field
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Carry all candidates into prediction, G, applicable F, prior/posterior and choice. Produce a coverage join; a target ID alone cannot identify two alternative cascades.
subjects.title: Keep identities through comparison
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Retain the selected full identity, actual enactor and rejected/unselected alternatives. Add a regression control for mission/ticket coverage and the prohibited allow-list. Selection source presence alone is not live choice evidence.
subjects.title: Bind the chosen policy to actuation
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Name channel, observed quantity, uncertainty convention and admitted precision update. Produce channel-to-term bindings with units and model revision. Distinguish nonnegative precision from a silently stronger positivity assumption.
subjects.title: Declare precision provenance
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Pin the accepted definition and mode for current fit or per-policy variational F. State which claim is active. Reuse the seeded pattern’s F/G distinction, not its historical Gaussian tick formula as a universal posterior law.
subjects.title: Identify the applicable F law
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Verify WM-11’s actual posterior consumer reads the same F values and candidate identities. Preserve a prior-only result as prior-only and record incomplete details as a failed coverage obligation.
subjects.title: Follow F into the posterior
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Check the reviewer acted independently on this subject and that evidence was not manufactured by the verdict-maker. Evaluate actual semantic predicates; tags alone do not establish origin.
subjects.title: Verify independence and meaning
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Select the member authorized for this grain and observation time, with provenance and composition inputs. Terminal machineC is one available member; an interpretation packet limiting itself to it did not waive general C. Output a member request and explicit unresolved dependencies on WM-13. Do not substitute the terminal member at every step because it is implemented.
subjects.title: Resolve the applicable member
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Bind both distributions to the same tagged outcome identities, model context and comparison schedule. If a bridge maps state or observations to dispositions, state its interpretation and validation evidence. A constant adapter that ignores its input does not establish state-dependent prediction. Output a checked Q/C envelope or a typed domain/bridge refusal.
subjects.title: Join Q and C by meaning
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Require normalized nonnegative preferences under the adopted numeric contract. Preserve the terminal seed’s seven named zeros; never smooth them to obtain a finite risk. Under the current risk-admissibility contract positive Q at zero C refuses finite scoring; zero-Q terms contribute zero. Output the support check and exact reason for any inadmissibility.
subjects.title: Preserve support and zeros
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Bind the source member, any fold and bridge, model revisions and independent review to the actual envelope. A proof with arbitrary C proves a conditional law, not that this C was constructed by the machine. Keep author tests, reviewed source and production use as separate evidence.
subjects.title: Bind the admitted preference
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Bind F1–F4 checks to the ruled predicates and actual supplied records. F2 expectations and F4 designation must not be inferred from the finder’s own output; citation validity is separately checked. Empty production designation is honestly vacuous and earns no discrimination. Whether a nonvacuous commissioning control suffices for qualification remains unresolved.
subjects.title: Check content and designation independently
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Bind the prior cascade, selected candidate set, source repository and admittedBy argument as distinct inputs. Retain before-state identity and provenance. Do not derive admission attribution from the output or treat organiser-added nodes as externally admitted.
subjects.title: Preserve the four inputs
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Use WM-02 belief, WM-03 dynamics and WM-04 observation A through WM-05, preserving guards, history, overlap and order. Retain q, J and Q for each scored observation. Joint prediction must change because interpreted effects change, not because an edge label receives an arbitrary bonus.
subjects.title: Construct the joint from interactions
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Under the finite categorical contract, G at each observation is KL(Q || C) plus expected conditional observation entropy under q; total G sums over the declared common schedule. Derive the equivalent preference cross-entropy minus state mutual information from the same J. It is not KL risk minus information gain. Preserve positive-Q/zero-C inadmissibility and numeric correspondence.
subjects.title: Calculate the canonical quantity
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Connect the canonical result to the actual choice consumer with policy, model and schedule identities. Retain failed/inadmissible candidates rather than silently shrinking coverage. A logged G alongside a controller score is not G-based choice. WM-11 owns the declared choice law over the applicable admitted alternatives.
subjects.title: Replace the missing scoring seam
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Retain full cascade, precedence, interpretation/model revisions, target and parent/delta where applicable. Two policies for one mission remain two policies. Record generated and excluded candidates and the reason for each exclusion; a missing model is not evidence that a candidate is impossible.
subjects.title: Define the actual candidate family
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Name whether this decision uses a base prior, habit prior, precision prior or observed-data posterior. The pinned semantics distinguishes these formulas and labels combined habit/precision forms as extensions. Retain sources of E and any precision, with domain and positivity requirements. No configurable scalar is automatically per-policy variational F.
subjects.title: Declare which probability law applies
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Validate the complete family and score/log-weight domains, including empty support and invalid evidence cases. A numerically stable implementation must correspond to the chosen law, not clip or default weights until it returns a distribution. Retain per-policy G, applicable F, E, precision and normalized mass with exact identities.
subjects.title: Normalize with declared numerical semantics
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Declare history, available guard information, precedence, repetition and termination at each level. A lower-level episode and a higher-level step need an explicit relation; hidden-state guard evaluation remains a stated approximation unless correspondence is established. Do not reset board state between steps merely to simplify an example.
subjects.title: Align nested execution semantics
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Start from the selected problem’s context and competing concerns. Read retrieved patterns as arguments and say which response could help. Keep an unhelpful result explicit; neither a mission tag nor a familiar title establishes fit. Output a source-bound interpretation attempt for WM-08/03.
subjects.title: Explain what the task needs
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Define what a useful result must enable in this situation: for example identifying missing handoff evidence or a justified next design change. Retain the assessment and its evidence. A lack of immediate score improvement is not automatically proof that retrieval was useless; distinguish interpretation failure, missing model inputs and genuine absence of an applicable response.
subjects.title: Judge retrieval usefulness against the work
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Read the actual pattern context, tension and rationale, then explain its task-specific interpretation and alternatives. Produce an applicability argument rather than rename code operations as patterns.
subjects.title: Explain the pattern response
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Resolve exact commission preimages, literal observation bytes and reviewer/producer authority. Preserve source and freshness pins. Reconstructed history is not an original, and a manifest is not acquired evidence.
subjects.title: Acquire independent original evidence
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Tamper with source, subject, model, occurrence, mandatory-edge and independence fields at acquisition and generated-certificate boundaries. Require rejection for the intended semantic condition, not merely malformed syntax.
subjects.title: Exercise the rejecting path end to end
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Name the actual human, agent and stakeholder recipients for the work, their delivery paths and evidence of receipt/use. Retain disagreements and inaccessible participants. A message emitted into a log does not show that the participant received or could act on it.
subjects.title: C: deliver feedback to every participant
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Test all four claims together on actual work: can participants retrieve the warranted account, receive feedback and question or revise the proposed goal through their authority? Retain independent findings and the consequences. No one successful query or accepted goal proposal proves all four.
subjects.title: Check the composed institutional arrangement
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Bind actual demand, supply, load and choice records to the scoped claims. Distinguish simulated inputs from observed demand and source mechanisms from effective consumer use. Retain constants and what their scales favor.
subjects.title: Examine real demand and load evidence
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Identify each required owner/reviewer from the evidence relied upon, role and current authority. Retain unresolved historical candidates, unavailable seats and documented succession. Do not infer exhaustive roster from currently connected agents.
subjects.title: Resolve responsibility and succession
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Declare L1 prediction-versus-model-realisation consistency as never-value-evidence, and L2 prediction versus independently witnessed outcome. Produce distinct estimands, domains and consumer claims; no combined pass flag.
subjects.title: Separate the two claims
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Resolve P121/P125/P130 against original Campaign S records, keeping source version, process identity and missing fields. Produce supported, refuted or unavailable historical claims. Later demonstrations cannot recover absent originals.
subjects.title: Reconcile historical evidence
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Use R20’s actual trips, history and restoration state with the declared composition order. Retain each factor and the effective result, including floors and saturation.
subjects.title: Compose monitoring inputs
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Compare selected and enacted semantics, re-observe the outcome independently and bind it to the next belief/choice. Keep re-observation distinct from proof that the act occurred; preserve mismatches for interpretation revision.
subjects.title: Compare and continue
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Take WM-04’s authorized observer, criterion, entity and time boundary. Keep the observer blind to posterior and disposition where required. Produce an observation request whose literal evidence can contradict the prediction.
subjects.title: Declare what can be observed
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Follow the ruled safety/stop response and applicable trip-to-R14 composition. Record active factors, modes and effective values. Do not invoke a seed’s nonblocking wording to bypass a required refusal.
subjects.title: Apply the admitted response and composition
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Trace the computed value into its actual consumer with an applicable sensitivity control. Record legitimate saturation or inapplicability without calling it successful modulation.
subjects.title: Demonstrate effective use
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Reconcile the catalogue, drawing, source and ruled conditional/retired edges. Produce a versioned node/edge universe including R3a hosting and R17 variants. Do not infer completeness from whichever logs exist.
subjects.title: Declare the required graph
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Bind problem, current partial construction, proposed extension, full interpreted policy and model context. Construction index k is not observation time or horizon T. Output a per-problem comparison request; a fixed authored list across all problems does not satisfy progressive construction.
subjects.title: Identify the design being compared
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Bind the enacted schedule, hierarchy, model and actual consumer to its receipt. Include controls for concrete compounding misspecification, cancellation/saturation and metadata-only attestation twins. Reject universal inequalities unsupported by the modeled dynamics. Mathematical examples and runtime configuration observations remain different evidence.
subjects.title: Retain the effective semantic configuration
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: Pass the actual folded member to WM-06 and retain which choice used it. A later preference revision retains its author, reason, affected grain and old evidence. Do not retrospectively reinterpret a past choice under the new C or claim a family exists because its type is populated by a dummy constant.
subjects.title: Trace governance and consumer use
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: When the library lacks the needed response, create a draft pattern with context, IF, HOWEVER, THEN, BECAUSE, sources and an explicit evidence hole. Preserve alternatives and failure modes. Do not rename an operation or invent attestation. Scope the ARGUE/genesis work and retain its parent problem and reason for creation.
subjects.title: Author a missing argument explicitly
subjects.author: codex-7

subjects.application: When picks do not help, retain the attempted strategy and why it failed, then change a declared query, source scope or search procedure. Keep prior results and bounded search coverage. Feed legal interpreted proposals into WM-09/10; no model-backed score is fabricated just to rank a newly authored pattern.
subjects.title: Revise search and construction
subjects.author: codex-7
